text:
sasha: Heads-up 1 I dropped a short 'What's New' blurb for the next docs deploy. Need a fast sweep: SDK snippet parity, one-line Dedicated platform note, and any Known issues to call out. PTAL :eyes:
rachel: Link please?
sasha: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/whatsnew/3477-draft 1 main things: embeddings API renamed to `embeddings.create_v2` and we found a quantization variance on older GPUs for long sequences (>2048).
tim: I can update Python. For the whatsnew page we prefer minimal inline snippets (1-3 lines) and point to full examples in the SDK migration guide.
rachel: Proposed Python inline: `resp = client.embeddings.create_v2(model="rwd-embed-1", input=["hello"])` I'll patch that in.
marta: I'll proof the prose. Also suggest a one-line enterprise note under Platform: "Dedicated: latency SLO slightly tightened for small-batch interactive workloads; contact sales for details."
sasha: Good. Leo, any other infra-known issues we should call out?
leo: Add a Known issue blurb: "Quantized models on older GPUs may produce minor logit differences for sequences >2048 tokens; re-evaluate scoring pipelines before rolling to production." Link to bug RED-2146. Also double-check anchors in routing docs 1 rollout-policy anchor was flaky earlier.
devex-bot: CI for PR #8394: linkcheck failed (rollout-policy anchor missing), lint passed. https://ci.internal/builds/8394
rachel: I'll fix the anchor and update the JS snippet. JS inline should use camelCase: `await client.embeddings.createV2({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: ['hello'] })`
tim: I'll update the migration guide with full examples and call out JS camelCase vs Python snake_case differences.
leo: After edits, I'll run staging linkcheck and quick QA. If all green we merge and schedule publish Tue 10:00 PT.
rachel: Pushed changes: fixed rollout-policy anchor, updated inline snippets, added Known issues paragraph and a 1-2 line troubleshooting tip recommending re-running evals with full precision for affected cases. Commit 4a7b2c.
leo: Re-run staging checks: linkcheck clean, preview looks correct; inline snippets render and migration link resolves. Minor nit: JS casing already updated.
sasha: Great. Marta, any final copy tweaks?
marta: Small wording change on the whatsnew lead for clarity. Pushed.
sasha: Cool. Merge when ready; schedule publish. Thanks team :tada:
